method: Monthly annuity rounded to cents; monthly interest rounded half-up to cents; final payment adjusted to settle the balance; upfront fee paid separately; no other costs. Feasibility uses the largest scheduled payment including the last. Annual effective cost is an illustrative cash-flow yield, not an asserted regulatory APR/TAEG.
formula: r = annual_rate_pct/1200; regular_payment = round_half_up(principal*r/(1-(1+r)**(-term_months)),2); monthly interest = round_half_up(balance*r,2); final payment = balance+final interest; cost = sum(interest)+upfront_fee.
